question: Identify the correct match of plant hormones with their functions.

options.text:

Abscisic acid: Help in the growth of the stem

Gibberellins: Inhibits growth

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gibberellins: Help in the growth of the stem, Cytokinins: Promote cell division, Abscisic acid: Inhibits growth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gibberellins:** These hormones significantly contribute to the elongation of stems and the growth of the plant.
 
• **Cytokinins:** They are essential for promoting cell division, especially in roots and shoots, leading to plant growth.
 
• **Abscisic acid:** This hormone primarily acts as a growth inhibitor and plays a crucial role in plant response to stress conditions like drought.
 
• Accurate knowledge of these hormones is vital for understanding plant physiology and improving agricultural practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Auxins:** A group of hormones that regulate various growth processes in plants, such as cell elongation, root formation, and differentiation.
 
• **Ethylene:** A gaseous hormone involved in the ripening of fruits, leaf abscission, and response to mechanical stress.
 
• **Brassinosteroids:** These hormones promote cell expansion and division, seed germination, and resistance to stress.
 
• **Jasmonates:** Involved in plant defense mechanisms against herbivores and pathogens, and also in regulating growth and development.
 
• **Salicylic acid:** Plays a crucial role in plant immunity, particularly in the systemic acquired resistance against pathogens.
